query:
SELECT touchKey, status, COUNT(*) as cnt, MIN(scheduledFor) as earliest
FROM leadSequenceQueue
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
GROUP BY touchKey, status
ORDER BY touchKey, status;
